morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动动词，词根 hina 保持不变，无鼻音同化；前缀与词根连写。本条纠正输入将 dihina 误判为词根的结果。Jawi 根据 di- 与已核实的 هينا 拼合。

senses.zh_definition: 被当作低人一等的人对待；遭到轻视或贬低。
senses.en_definition: To be treated as inferior or unworthy; to be demeaned or looked down on.
senses.ms_definition: Diperlakukan sebagai orang yang rendah taraf atau martabatnya; dipandang rendah.
senses.nuances: 是 menghina 的被动形式，突出受辱者承受的待遇。此释义依据 DBP 的 hina／menghina 条目编写，并非独立 dihina 词条的逐字引文。di- 本身不表示过去时；可说 sedang dihina 或 akan dihina。frequency_rank 沿用输入数据。[DBP PRPM：hina](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hina)

collocations.en: looked down on for being poor

senses.zh_definition: 受到辱骂、嘲弄或贬损名誉的言行攻击；被侮辱。
senses.en_definition: To be insulted or subjected to contemptuous words or actions.
senses.ms_definition: Dicela, dikeji atau disakiti perasaannya melalui kata-kata atau perbuatan yang merendahkan maruah.
senses.nuances: 比普通的不赞同或批评更强，通常涉及尊严受损。dihina 描述遭受侮辱，berasa terhina 强调主观感受；两者相关但不能在所有句子中互换。[DBP PRPM：hina](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hina)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 员工申诉
dual_scenarios.ms: Pekerja itu melaporkan bahawa dia sering dihina oleh penyelianya di hadapan rakan sekerja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该员工反映，他经常在同事面前遭主管侮辱。
dual_scenarios.en: The employee reported that his supervisor frequently insulted him in front of his colleagues.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku tak nak dihina macam tu lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya tidak mahu dihina seperti itu lagi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我不想再被那样羞辱了。
dual_scenarios.en: I don't want to be treated like that again.
spoken_features: aku 用于熟人之间的非正式自称
tak nak 对应 tidak mahu
macam tu 对应 seperti itu
口语中仍可完整保留被动前缀 di-

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dihina depan semua orang tadi. Aku dah tak nak jumpa dia.
messages.ms_standard: Saya dihina di hadapan semua orang tadi. Saya tidak mahu berjumpa dengannya lagi.
messages.zh: 刚才我当着所有人的面被羞辱了。我不想再见他。
messages.en: He humiliated me in front of everyone earlier. I don't want to see him again.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau tak patut dihina macam tu. Kalau nak cerita, aku ada je.
messages.ms_standard: Awak tidak sepatutnya dihina seperti itu. Jika awak mahu bercerita, saya sedia mendengar.
messages.zh: 你不该被那样对待。想聊的话，我随时听你说。
messages.en: You didn't deserve that. I'm here if you want to talk.

etymology.historical_story: The base hina is generally traced to Sanskrit hīna, associated with deficiency, inferiority and low status. Malay developed a productive family around this borrowed base. Adding the Malay passive prefix di- produces dihina, shifting attention to the person receiving contempt. The resulting word combines an older borrowed root with ordinary, still productive Malay grammar. [Sanskrit Words in Southeast Asian Languages](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/529), [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=hina)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hina 联想“低看”；di- 把镜头转向承受者：menghina＝侮辱别人，dihina＝被别人侮辱。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: dihina 是分量较重的表述，表示尊严受到伤害。正式申诉中配合具体言行和场景描述，有助于清楚表达事件。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于讨论霸凌、歧视、辱骂和尊严受损。一般建设性批评通常称 dikritik；安慰受辱者时避免用“只是开玩笑”淡化其经历。
